meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求完成迁移时,Claude 会检查迁移进度文件,然后帮你完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 迁移的收尾:确认所有者账号、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置、处理自定义代码,最后运行验证。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from v1”“finish migration”“v1 migration”等,或要求继续迁移时触发。需要先运行过 bash migrate-v2.sh 脚本。

say.text: 帮我完成从 v1 到 v2 的迁移
继续迁移,处理遗留步骤
say.note: 会读取 handoff.json 逐项继续

say.text: 迁移后把我的账号设为所有者
say.note: 会确认用户并授予 owner 角色

howto.what_en: After enabling, when you ask to continue migration, Claude checks the handoff file, then finishes the v1→v2 migration: confirms the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, ports custom v1 code, and runs verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like 'migrate from v1', 'finish migration', or 'v1 migration', or when you ask to continue the migration. Requires that 'bash migrate-v2.sh' has already been completed.

say_en.text: Help me complete the migration from v1 to v2.
say_en.note: Claude first checks whether migrate-v2.sh has run.

say_en.text: Continue the migration and handle the remaining steps.
say_en.note: Reads handoff.json and proceeds item by item.

say_en.text: Set my account as owner after migration.
say_en.note: Confirms your user and grants the owner role.
